release_notes:
Add-credits & email fixes, supplier price-sync, and DHRU Fusion Pro support

New
- CRON Logs: a "Write cron status to database" switch — keep cron logging off in normal operation and turn it on only while troubleshooting, then off again.

Fixes
- Add Credits no longer fails for a customer whose balance was empty or never set — on PHP 8 this silently did nothing; credits now post correctly and create the invoice/history.
- Emails & newsletters: subjects and bodies with special characters (en-dash, emoji, accents) now arrive correctly instead of as garbled text such as "â€“".
- Service lists (IMEI / Server / Retail): paging past page 1 while viewing "All" statuses no longer lands on an empty page — the status filter is now carried across pages.
- Supplier price sync:
  - Switching a service's supplier no longer silently freezes its price — the margin carries over to the new supplier and automatic price updates continue.
  - The "API History" price shown on a service now reflects the supplier's current price instead of the last manual sync.
  - Automatic price updates, low-balance alerts, and the price cron now support DHRU Fusion Pro (REST) suppliers.
- Telegram order/credit alerts addressed by email now send reliably (an internal query error was dropping them).

Under the hood
- Duplicate or conflicting supplier-margin rows can no longer be created (new uniqueness guard), preventing wrong markups after a supplier switch.
